title: What's New popup & changelog
description: Added a changelog popup that shows new features on first visit, with per-entry priority, startup preference in Settings, and a full scrollable changelog view.

title: Drag-and-drop page reordering
description: Pages in the sidebar can now be dragged to reorder or reparent them into a different parent.

title: Unified dev server startup
description: Running npm run dev now starts both the frontend and backend together via a Vite API proxy — no more two separate terminals.

title: Unified activity bar & mobile nav
description: Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom bar are now a single NavBar component, giving a consistent look across screen sizes.

title: VS Code-style activity bar with icons
description: Navigation moved to a left-side activity bar with Lucide icons on desktop; previous text-only tabs removed.
